jobs.description:
Werde Teil von etwas Grösserem. Arbeite mit über 2000 Spezialistinnen und Spezialisten aus mehr als 100 Berufen zusammen und ermögliche querschnittgelähmten Menschen ein selbstbestimmtes Leben. Auf dem modernen Campus in Nottwil erwartet dich eine inspirierende Atmosphäre und interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe.

Dich erwarten nicht nur attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen, sondern auch zahlreiche weitere Vorteile. Freu dich auf eine sinnstiftende Arbeit in einem modernen Arbeitsumfeld, flexible Arbeitszeiten und vielfältige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten. Komm zu uns und erlebe unseren einzigartigen Spirit.

Das Schweizer Paraplegiker-Zentrum in Nottwil ist eine private, national und international anerkannte Spezialklinik für Querschnitt-, Rücken- und Beatmungsmedizin. Als Akut- und Rehabilitationsklinik bietet das Zentrum seinen Patientinnen und Patienten eine umfassende Betreuung und unterstützt sie ein Leben lang. The social and peer consulting services department provides comprehensive support to cross-sectional paralyses in all regions of the country. The consultations take place at our location in Nottwil, partly in hospitals, at home or by telephone. We advise on questions concerning social security, finances, housing, employment or personal topics.

To expand our team of social work we are looking for an empathetic and professionally experienced personality.

Tasks:
• Psychosocial counselling and support for people with spinal cord injury or cross-sectional diagnoses and their relatives

• settlement of claims in the field of social security and ensuring the economic viability of the company

• Support in the preparation and submission of applications for social security and foundations

• Support in challenging life situations and change processes (e.g. professional reorientation, separation, transition to AHV age)

• Promoting the autonomy of clients

• Interdisciplinary cooperation with relevant bodies and partner organisations

• Writing of specialist articles for your own media

Requirements:
• You have completed a training course in social work FH/BSC with appropriate professional experience

• You have a knowledge of social security systems

• You can design your work flexibly and independently – even in the private office of your clients at home in the private office of the company

• You like to bring your knowledge and experiences into projects

• Your German is style-proof, French and/or English skills are advantageous

• You appreciate the work in an interdisciplinary team

We offer: You not only expect attractive employment conditions, but also numerous other advantages. Look forward to a sun-sustaining work in a modern working environment, flexible working hours and diverse training opportunities. Come to us and experience our unique spirit. More information on parplegie.ch/vortragungen.

The Swiss Paraplegic Association (SPV), founded in 1980, is the national umbrella organisation of paraplegic paraplegics with around 11,000 members. It promotes, represents and coordinates the concerns of paraplegics and tetraplegics as well as other members throughout Switzerland. It also supports 27 regional wheelchair clubs throughout Switzerland.

The 80 permanent employees and 170 freelancers, as well as more than 2,000 volunteers and volunteers, are committed to social, social, political and personal interests of the members and are committed to their reintegration and the improvement of the quality of life. The services offered include the Institute for Legal Advice, Wheelchair Sports and Leisure (promotion of top and grassroots sports, as well as own travel agency), the Centre for Preventive Building and the Life Consulting Division.

The SPV also publishes the member magazine Para Contact and two newsletters.

Diventa parte di qualcosa di più grande. Lavorare con più di 2000 specialisti di oltre 100 professioni e permettere alle persone paraplegiche di vivere una vita autodeterminata. Nel campus moderno di Nottwil, un'atmosfera stimolante e la cooperazione interdisciplinare a livello degli occhi vi aspetta. Stiamo cercando un assistente medico nel campo della neurochirurgia o della chirurgia ortopedica e della traumatologia del sistema muscoloscheletrico con interesse ed esperienza nel campo della chirurgia spinale a partire dall'estate 2026. L'occupazione è inizialmente limitata a un anno. Dopo aver ottenuto lo status di specialista e l'impegno eccezionale, una promozione da/per Stv. Il medico senior e l'estensione del rapporto di lavoro in comune accordo, per cui c'è anche la possibilità di formazione parziale o completa per la chirurgia della colonna vertebrale di messa a fuoco.

Compiti:
• Sotto la supervisione di un medico cadre, si prende cura dei pazienti nella consultazione di chirurgia spinale e li supporta nella cura dei pazienti inpatici

• Si assiste con operazioni, infiltrazioni sulla colonna vertebrale e le grandi articolazioni e può eseguire questi sotto supervisione a seconda dello stato di allenamento.

• Amministrativamente, sarete sollevati dal dipartimento di medicina acuta e riabilitativa nella cura inpatia dei pazienti, che consente di concentrarsi di più su questioni mediche

• Lavori a stretto contatto con colleghi in medicina acuta, riabilitazione, clinica del dolore, chirurgia plastica, radiologia, fisioterapia, terapia occupazionale e molte altre aree specializzate

• Partecipate attivamente all'insegnamento, alla ricerca e all'ulteriore istruzione

Requisiti
• Hai diversi anni di esperienza clinica con focus spinale riconoscibile. Idealmente, sei vicino a completare la tua formazione specialistica e hai intenzione di completare la formazione chirurgica spinale specializzata SGNC/SO.

• Hai completato una laurea in medicina (per i diplomi stranieri con il riconoscimento MEBEKO) e hai una buona conoscenza orale e scritta del tedesco (livello minimo C1).

• Sei una personalità di team-capable, impegnata e resiliente con alta competenza sociale e professionale.

• Grande senso di responsabilità, uno stile di comunicazione aperto e piacevole e la volontà di cooperazione interdisciplinare / interprofessionale ti distinguono.

• L'esperienza scientifica è benefica in caso di applicazione.

Offriamo:
Non solo si aspettano condizioni di lavoro attraenti, ma anche numerosi altri vantaggi. Attendere un lavoro significativo in un ambiente di lavoro moderno, orari di lavoro flessibili e una vasta gamma di ulteriori opportunità di istruzione. Venite a vivere il nostro spirito unico.

Come clinica acuta e riabilitativa, il centro offre ai suoi pazienti una cura completa e li sostiene per tutta la vita. La clinica fa parte del Gruppo svizzero Paraplegic, che fornisce una rete di servizi unica nel mondo per la riabilitazione olistica di persone con paraplegia.

Become part of something bigger. Work with more than 2000 specialists from more than 100 professions and enable paraplegic people to live a self-determined life. On the modern campus in Nottwil, an inspiring atmosphere and interdisciplinary cooperation at eye level awaits you.

We are looking for an assistant physician in the field of neurosurgery or orthopaedic surgery and traumatology of the musculoskeletal system with interest and experience in the field of spinal surgery as of summer 2026. The employment is initially limited to one year. Upon obtaining the specialist status and outstanding commitment, a promotion to/from Stv. Senior physician as well as an extension of the working relationship in mutual agreement, whereby there is also the option for partial or complete further training for the focus spine surgery. Tasks: • Under the supervision of a cadre doctor, you look after patients in the spinal surgery consultation and support them in the care of inpatient patients • You assist with operations, infiltrations on the spine and the large joints and can carry out these under supervision depending on your training status. • Administratively, you will be relieved by the department of acute and rehabilitation medicine in the inpatient care of patients, which allows you to focus more on medical matters • You work closely with colleagues in acute medicine, rehabilitation, pain clinic, plastic surgery, radiology, physiotherapy, occupational therapy and many other specialist areas • You actively participate in teaching, research and further education Requirements • You have several years of clinical experience with recognizable spinal focus. Ideally, you are close to completing your specialist training and intend to complete the specialised spinal surgery training SGNC/SO. • You have completed a medical degree (for foreign diplomas with MEBEKO recognition) and have very good oral and written knowledge of German (minimum level C1). • You are a team-capable, committed and resilient personality with high social and professional competence. • Great sense of responsibility, an open and pleasant communication style and the willingness for interdisciplinary / interprofessional cooperation distinguish you. • Scientific experience is beneficial in the case of an application. We offer: You not only expect attractive employment conditions, but also numerous other advantages. Look forward to meaningful work in a modern working environment, flexible working hours and a wide range of further education opportunities. Come and experience our unique spirit.
